title: Build the guided project and property onboarding wizard
summary: Implemented a persisted six-step project/property onboarding wizard with composed organization-scoped permissions, tenant- and actor-bound drafts, safe navigation/resume, PostgreSQL concurrency and idempotency controls, atomic website/mobile provisioning, ownership challenge handoff, read-only plan impact, factual readiness, cancellation, privacy-safe instrumentation, accessible no-JavaScript UI, and synchronized documentation.
